items.text: Kwaŋin aponi kimarai Isirael kere kwape ajaar auriokee; ido koany iwadikatai oitabo loka ikabakan luka Isirael; kijoreoroi Yuda Babulon kanuka adiakarikee.
Luageete aiboikin airumetakee, oreriakee kes lu, Isirael, isasedotin, Ilebin, ka Inetinim,
Kibojete ko Yerusalem lukodwe luka Yuda, ka lukodwe luka Benyamin, ka lukodwe luka Epuraim ka Manase;
Utai okoku loka Amikud, okoku loka Omiri, okoku loka Imiri, okoku loka Bani, Iokodwe luka Peres okoku loka Yuda,
Luka Isilonin; Asaia ekiyaike, ka odweke.
Lukodwe luka Sera; Yeuel, ka iinaeanakee, akwat akanykape ka akaisakanykaoŋon,
Lukodwe luka Benyamin; Salu okoku loka Mesulam, okoku loka Kodabia, okoku loka Kasenua;
ka Ibuneia okoku loka Yerokam, ka Ela okoku loka Usi, okoku loka Mikiri, ka Mesulam okoku loka Sepatia, okoku loka Reuel, okoku loka Ibiniya;
ka iinacanakec, kwape ajaatar aturiokee, akwat akanykaoŋon ka akaisakany ka lukanykape. Ituŋa ŋul kere kes ikapolok luka ikekia luka lukapapaakee kwape ajaatar ikekia luka lukapapaakec.
Lukosasedotin; Yedaia, ka Yekoi-arib, ka Yakin;
ka Asaria okoku loka Kilikia, okoku loka Mesulam, okoku loka Sadok, okoku loka Meraiot, okoku loka Akitub, ekapolokiton etogo loka Edeke;
ka Adaia okoku loka Yerokam, okoku loka Pasur, okoku loka Malikiya, ka Maasai okoku loka Adiel, okoku loka Yasera, okoku loka Mesulam, okoku loka Mesilemit, okoku loka Imer;
ka iinaeanakec, ikapolok luka ikekia luka lukapapaakee, elukumit ka akwat akanykaarei ka akaisakanykapc; ituŋa lukapedor noi aswam aijaanakin naka etogo loka Edeke.
Luka Ilebin; Semaia okoku loka Kasub, okoku loka Asirikam, okoku loka Kasabia, lokodwe luka Merari;
ka Bakabakar, Keres, ka Galal, ka Matania okoku loka Mika, okoku loka Sikiri, okoku loka Asap;
ka Obadia okoku loka Semaia, okoku loka Galal, okoku loka Yedutun, ka Berekia okoku loka Asa, okoku loka Elukana, lueboienenete koreria ludidik luka Inetopatin.
Ka ikagolok; Salum, ka Akub, ka Talumon, ka Akiman, ka iinaeanakec: Salum ŋes ekapolon;
lu lem kidarenenete erute loka ekabaka ari nakokide: keraas kesi ikagolok luka iidukurun luka idwe luka Lebi.

Koanyanar Salum okoku loka Kore, okoku loka Ebiasap, okoku loka Kora, ka iinacanake, lukokek loka papaake, Ikorakin, aswam naka aijaanakin, ikagolok luka ikekia luka Ewema lokalaunan: keraas lukapapaakee ikapolok luka iidukurun luka EJAKAIT, ikagolok luka ekek;
Kerai Pinekas okoku loka Eleasar ekapolonikee kolo sek, kojai EJAKAIT kaŋes,
Kerai Sekaria okoku loka Meselemia ekagolon loka ekek loka ewema loka airiamunun.

Ŋul kerc luaponi koseunai araun ikagolok luka ikekia, emwaasi akwat aarei ka itomon ka luarei. Aponi nul kimarai kauriokee koreriakee ludidik, luapotu Daudi ka Samuel ekadwaran kotiakut aswam aswamukec nakemunoi.
Kosodete kesi ka idwekec koanyanarete ikekia lukotogo loka EJAKAIT, ŋes etogo loka ewema lokalaunan, kameanakin.
Keiaananas ikagolok owaitin iwonon, kide, ka to, ka eŋalakimak, ka agolitomei.
Koponenenete iinaeanakec, koreriakec ludidik, kanunupaarasia akanykaarei apakio kapakio ajaut kakes:
Naarai ikagolok luonon lukapolok, lukeraas Ilebin, ajaas kaswam naatiakakinitai, kopolokinito agolai ka aiŋadisia nuka iboro kaluketiai kotogo loka Edeke.
Kiboienenete airimor etogo loka Edeke, naarai aidar nakee, nakee da anaanar ŋinitupuruc.
Kidarenenete ice kakesi iboro luka aijaanakin; naarai emareneneo nakitolomanarere ka nakitolomununere.
Kotiakakinitcte ice kakesi aidar iboro lukotogo, ka iboro kere luka aibois nakalaunan, ka akiria nuidieie, ka ebino, ka akinyet, ka lukisupurununo, ka lueur maa.
Kitemokis ice kodwe luka isasedotin eiswamae loka lueur maa.
Aponi kotiakakinitete Matitia, ediopet koLebin, lokerai ekiyai loka Salum Ekorakit aidar iboro lupeon.
Kopolokinito ice koinacanakee, lukodwe luka Ikokatin akiro nuka cmugati loka aitodikin, aitemokin ŋes ninipaaran nakasabato,
Ŋul kes ikayook, ikapolok luka ikekia luka lukapapaakec luka Ilebin, lueboienenete kagolai Iuemameete aceswam: naarai kiswamaenenere aswamukec apaaran ka akuar.
Ŋul kes ikapolok luka ikekia luka lukapapaakec luka Ilebin, anatar aturiokee, ikapolok: kiboienenete nul koYerusalem,
Kiboie Yeicl, papa loka Gibeon, koGibeon, ekiror loka akeberu Maaka:
Abudon okokuke lokiyai, ka Sur, ka Kis, ka Baal, ka Ner, ka Nadab;
ka Gedor, ka Akio, ka Sekaria, ka Mikilot.
Mikilot kouri Simeam. Kibojete kesi da kiinaeanakee koYerusalem, eiduny kiinacanakec,
Ner kouri Kis; Kis kouri Saul; Saul kouri Yonatan, ka Malikisua, ka Abinadab, ka Es-baal.
Okoku loka Yonatan ŋes Merib-baal; Merib-baal kouri Mika.
Odwe luka Mika; Piton, ka Mclek, ka Tarea, ka Akas.
Akas kouri Yara; Yara kouri Alemet, ka Asumabet, ka Simiri; Simiri kouri Mosa:
Mosa kouri Binea; ka Repaia okokuke, Eleasa okokuke, Asel okokuke:
Kejaas Ascl odwe ikanykape, ikecekiroria lu; Asirikam, ka Bokeru, ka Isimael, ka Scaria, ka Obadia, ka Kanan: nul kes odwe luka Asel.
